title: Weighted procurement scorecard with mandatory safeguards
purpose: Ranks candidate AI products using weighted evidence domains while enforcing non-compensatory safety, privacy, equity, cybersecurity, audit, and exit safeguards.
input: `Scores` sheet with vendor, domain, score, weight, evidence confidence, safeguard_pass, and comment; `Parameters` sheet with minimum overall score and minimum domain score.
outputs: Weighted and confidence-adjusted scores, failed safeguards, ranked vendors, radar-style profile, and proceed/conditional/stop recommendation.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
